explain: Every 30 min for 14 cycles (about 6.6 h): first I'll listen to Bluetooth LE for 2 minutes, keeping only trackers. If a device has not been seen before, I'll send you an urgent alert. Then I'll listen to cell towers (with the modem) for 2 minutes. If a cell is a 2G cell, I'll send you an urgent alert. If a cell is on an unknown network, I'll send you an urgent alert.
limitations: Receive-only: no radio transmitted during this run.
Detections are what the receiver plugin decoded in this window, at the recorded gains. Devices that did not transmit, were out of range, or were not decoded are not listed.
Peak levels and clipping are measured from received samples. Front-end overload is inferred from them, not measured directly.
Devices are followed between steps by address. BLE devices that rotate their random address (phones, AirTags every ~15 min) can appear as new.
